core.title: Shaker Rose Doorbell Button, Fusion B-EL-S8

text.description_html:
Fusion B-EL-S8, Old World Shaker Doorbell Button

There is something unmistakably old world to the Shaker Rose Doorbell Button. Maybe its the timeless design, a rectangular with a inset groove along the edge. The Fusion made doorbell comes packaged with decorative trim plate, illuminated doorbell actuator, all all the necessary mounting screws.

Please Note This is a replacement trim only. It comes packaged with lighted button, rosette, and installation screws. It DOES NOT include the chime.

Specifications of the Shaker Doorbell Fusion S8:

  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Length: 4-1/4"
  • Width: 2-1/2"
  • Projection: 3/8"
  • Includes lighted button.
  • Packaged as a kit with matching finish installation screws and a lighted button.



** This item is discontinued. See available Door Bell Buttons
